newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq names executive to run daily operations.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq names executive to run daily operations.

text.p: The Nasdaq Stock Market annoounced Wednesday it appointed J. Patrick Campbell to the newly created senior management position of executive vice president for market services.
In that position, Campbell will have day-to-day responsibility for the operation of the screen-based market, including all market services offered by it, Nasdaq said.

Campbell, who is currently a director and senior executive vice president at The Ohio Co, a Columbus-based investment bank and financial advisory firm, is expected to join Nasdaq in January, Nasdaq said.
Campbell joined the firm in 1970 and is currently responsible for equity trading, research, portfolio management and retirement plans admninistration.
He was a member of the Nasdaq board between 1990 and 1993 and was a member of the Cincinnati Stock Exchange board between 1980 and 1985.
